bb.name: Horizontal Tabs
bb.description: Experimental: it may break with a bb update. Browser-style tabs across the top of bb's main panel, each holding a whole split layout. Clicking a tab brings back its panes at their exact sizes, with the same pane focused. + opens a tab on the New thread screen, and × or a middle-click closes one. Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab step through tabs and Alt+1–9 go to one, all rebindable. Clicking a thread in the sidebar goes to the tab that has it open, and a middle-click opens it in a new tab; Cmd/Ctrl-click still opens it in a split, as in bb. Each tab is named after its focused pane's thread and shows the initials of the projects open in it. Each pane keeps its own header below the strip.
